payload.name: CareClinic Health Tracker
payload.description: CareClinic is a free personal health journal for recording symptoms, medications, mood, sleep, routines, and appointments in one place. It helps people and caregivers keep an organized record over time and prepare shareable summaries for conversations with clinicians. It is a self-management and organization tool and does not diagnose conditions or replace professional care.

payload.name: Special Needs Jobs
payload.description:
Hi there,

I'm Kyle, and I run Special Needs Jobs over at specialneedsjobs.org. It's a free job board for ABA therapy roles across the US: BCBAs, RBTs, and behavior technicians, with pay, location, and work setting on each listing, plus free job alerts by email.

I was looking through your resources page and thought we could be a helpful addition for your readers. Would you consider adding us?

Thanks for the work you do,
Kyle

payload.name: MedicaidWorkCheck.com
payload.description: MedicaidWorkCheck.com is an independent, plain-English information site about the new federal Medicaid work requirement. Free tools include an 8-question exemption checker that becomes a private 80-hour monthly work tracker (no sign-up; all data stays in the visitor's browser), plain-English guides to every exemption category, 51 state-by-state guides, a living lawsuit tracker, and a full Spanish-language section.
